title: Kimi no Negai ga Kanau Made
titleRomaji: Kimi no Negai ga Kanau Made
titleNative: きみの願いが叶うまで
synopsis: For his high school debut, Minto Shishidou pretended to be an outgoing playboy, spinning lies about the girlfriends he goes through. This corner he backed himself into weighs heavily on his mind when he joins a school trip, and he’s determined to use the occasion to get a girlfriend for real. But then an unimaginable incident strikes him and his classmates, setting the stage for a locked-room love comedy centered around the wishes of these boys and girls. (Source: Natalie, translated)

I Was Taken in by a Fallen Noble House, so I'll Repay Their Kindness by Helping Them Rise Again
Datsuraku Shita Kizokuke ni Hirowaretanode Ongaeshi de Hukkou Sasemasu
synopsis: Leon, a former abandoned child taken in by a fallen noble family ruined by deceitful aristocrats, determined to repay the love and kindness shown to him by his new family, vows to restore their household. Using his talent for magic, he enrolls in a magic academy with the goal of becoming a great mage. While he is blessed with like-minded friends, worthy rivals, and dependable mentors, he also faces many formidable figures—such as arrogant nobles who abuse their status, and a suspicious second prince of the kingdom hiding something beneath the surface. Academy life turns out to be far more chaotic and eventful than he ever imagined! A heartfelt tale of a kind-hearted boy rising through the ranks with the power he’s honed—this full-fledged magical academy fantasy novel finally gets its long-awaited manga adaptation!
